# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.69

## Fixed

- Multi-RX patient review in Backoffice RX Profile Sync now displays the
  complete active RX history for each patient card. Matching historical rows
  are visible but cannot be selected; only pending differences can be synced.

## Safety

- No record changes occur during scanning. Synchronization remains manual,
  audited, and limited to 100 selected RX records per batch. No migration or
  business-data change is included.
